text: Hill-climb results (isolated worktree /private/tmp/scalafim-buildperf, private sbt global base; host load avg 20-65, so medians). Gate = sbt mvpaJVM/test (118 tests, ~1-3s of sbt task time). H0 cold JVM: median 65.6s (63.8, 65.6, 136.4) -> ~95% is JVM start + loading 14 nested pin builds. Load-only: base 2 CPUs 56-112s; H1a ActiveProcessorCount=4 34-54s KEEP; H1c ParallelGC 51-68s DROP; H1b AppCDS 50-68s DROP. H2 warm server via sbt --client: first call 48s (boot), then 1.1/1.0/0.7s per gate KEEP (~60x). H4 per-worktree global base seeded by APFS clonefile (cp -c) of a pin-keyed template: 4.9s clone, ~6MB real disk, first boot 66s, then 0.7s KEEP. Removes shared mutable staging, so builds in different worktrees need no global lock. Prototype tools/build/sbt-warm (perf/build-throughput-20261001): per-worktree base under ~/.cache/scalafim-sbt/bases/<worktree hash>, pin template ~/.cache/scalafim-sbt/templates/<pin key>, resident server with Global/serverIdleTimeout 30 min, 3-slot host command semaphore, ordered multi-command, exit codes propagate (bad command -> 1). Verified: bootstrap 77.5s + template save; warm 0.7s; new worktree on same pins seeded from template, first JVM 99s / JS 14s while a second worktree ran 5 warm gates at 1-5s concurrently (no interference, no global lock). Dogfooded on M3.03 worktree (different pins -> own template): edit + suite JVM/JS + full mvpaJVM/JS gates = 30s wall total. Deferred: H3 binary pins (would only shorten first boot per worktree; survey found 4 blockers: multivar test->test dep, ravel stencil/packed publish skip, nested SNAPSHOT coordinates, two gale revisions).
